subject: megaman
about: A Cross chosen while a Soul is united, BN6's engine alone (BN5 has no Cross; the Souls track's S2): KnightSoul united at the first turn (a deck of JustcOne J, UNITE), HeatCross chosen on the second Custom screen's CROSSSELECT (its flag E2 set): MegaMan leaves the proxy for HeatCross as the turn starts, the Soul gone (one form at a time), its used bit kept for the battle, HeatCross's used bit set.
expect_why: One form at a time (docs/multirom/one-net.md): a Cross chosen while a Soul is united is committed as BN6 commits a Cross (0x0802937A: its form, its used bit 0 for HeatCross), and the turn's crossing leaves form 8 through its removal entry (src/emu/soullife.c), which clears the Soul.
